newsitem.title: FRANCE: Socgen has no comment on Alcatel stake sale.
newsitem.headline: Socgen has no comment on Alcatel stake sale.

text.p: French bank Societe Generale said on Wednesday it had no comment on a market rumour that it had sold its 4.8 percent stake in telecommunications giant Alcatel Alsthom.
"I cannot comment on such rumours," a bank spokeswoman said.
Market sources said that a block of 14 million shares in Alcatel were traded off-market and Societe Generale and Morgan Stanley had executed the sale.
At Alcatel a spokesman had no immediate comment.

A spokesman for the French stock market association SBF said he was not aware of such an off-market trade during market hours and would not be able to confirm before Thursday morning if such a trade had taken place after the close.
Alcatel shares closed down 1.68 percent at 762 francs.
